name: @pipeworx/mcp-mhw

tools.name: get_monsters
tools.description: Search Monster Hunter World monsters by name, species, or size class. Returns species classification, elements, ailments, and weaknesses to plan hunts.

name.description: Filter by monster name (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "nergigante".

species.description: Filter by species. One of: elder dragon, flying wyvern, brute wyvern, bird wyvern, fanged wyvern, piscine wyvern, fanged beast, neopteron, herbivore, wingdrake, relict, fish.

limit.description: Maximum number of monsters to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_weapons
tools.description: Browse Monster Hunter World weapons by type (e.g., 'Great Sword', 'Bow', 'Hammer'). Returns damage, elements, and rarity to match your playstyle.

type.description: Filter by weapon type. One of: great-sword, sword-and-shield, dual-blades, long-sword, hammer, hunting-horn, lance, gunlance, switch-axe, charge-blade, insect-glaive, light-bowgun, heavy-bowgun, bow. Omit to return all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of weapons to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_armor
tools.description: Find Monster Hunter World armor by rank and type. Returns defense, elemental resistances, and skill slots for building effective sets.

limit.description: Maximum number of armor pieces to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Look up Monster Hunter World skills by name. Returns descriptions, max ranks, and level-by-level effects to optimize your build.

limit.description: Maximum number of skills to return. Defaults to 20.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mhw forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mhw pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
